protocols.name: REST
protocols.does: One HTTP client per test on IHttpClientFactory, JSON shape assertions, shared authentication, request and response capture, and endpoint coverage.

protocols.name: GraphQL
protocols.does: Queries, mutations and subscriptions over WebSocket or SSE, file uploads, shape assertions and schema coverage.

protocols.name: gRPC
protocols.does: Unary and streaming calls, metadata authentication through the shared

protocols.name: OpenAPI
protocols.does: Compares REST traffic and shape assertions against your OpenAPI document and reports the endpoints, responses and properties no test has checked.

browsers.name: Web
browsers.does: A driver-independent model of pages, components, elements, tables, flows and login, with page coverage and failure artifacts.

messaging.name: Messaging
messaging.does: Publish to a destination, then await the message that matters with a predicate and a timeout; an in-memory broker by default.

messaging.name: RabbitMQ
messaging.does: A real broker adapter, with a broker owned by the run when it should start one.

messaging.name: MassTransit
messaging.does: Bridges the messaging surface to an in-process application's MassTransit test harness, and the envelope helper speaks the wire format over any adapter.

devices-preview.name: Devices
devices-preview.does: Typed device clients, one instance per test, frame exchange and device-protocol coverage.

devices-preview.name: WebSocket transport
devices-preview.does: Ws:// and wss:// endpoints, or in-process sockets through the application's test server.

devices-preview.name: MQTT transport
devices-preview.does: Publish and subscribe against a real broker, with a Mosquitto broker owned by the run.

data-and-files.name: Test data
data-and-files.does: Deterministic builders with member defaults, factories and provisioners, so a test writes only the values it is about.

data-and-files.name: SQL
data-and-files.does: A database connection each test owns, optional transaction rollback, EF Core contexts on the same connection, and a PostgreSQL server owned by the run.

data-and-files.name: Sheets
data-and-files.does: Opens the .xlsx your application generated and asserts on cells, ranges, tables and typed rows, with range coverage.

applications-and-runs.name: ASP.NET Core
applications-and-runs.does: Runs the application in-process with WebApplicationFactory and hands its HttpClient to the REST and GraphQL clients.

applications-and-runs.name: Background workers
applications-and-runs.does: Runs a generic host with its IHostedServices inside the test process, the way ASP.NET Core runs an API.

applications-and-runs.name: Aspire
applications-and-runs.does: Starts an Aspire AppHost with the run and publishes each resource's endpoint as its application's address.

fakes.name: WireMock
fakes.does: A fake HTTP service per test or per run, with stubs, call verification, trace evidence and stub coverage.

foundation-and-support.name: Foundation
foundation-and-support.does: The host, execution context, hooks, attributes, test ids, tracing and resources every integration plugs into.

foundation-and-support.name: HTTP plumbing
foundation-and-support.does: The shared client pipeline and the

foundation-and-support.name: JSON shapes
foundation-and-support.does: Partial shape matching and JsonValue constraints; normally transitive.

foundation-and-support.name: Containers
foundation-and-support.does: The run-scoped container base: start once, release once, with TryStart for a run that has no container runtime.

foundation-and-support.name: Page inventory
foundation-and-support.does: Page identities and inventory shared by the browser and ASP.NET Core integrations; normally transitive.

runners.name: Test runners
runners.does: The same runtime in every runner, with one assertion and attachment model.

tooling-and-agent.name: The CLI
tooling-and-agent.does: The prototest tool: summary, index, verify and feedback over a trace, a folder of runs or two reports, with no agent in the loop.

tooling-and-agent.name: Traces
tooling-and-agent.does: The .prototrace archive and the reader that opens it: the run's operations, checks and artifacts in one file.

tooling-and-agent.name: MCP server
tooling-and-agent.does: A local stdio server that answers questions about the runs in a repository through four read-only tools.

tooling-and-agent.name: Diagnosis
tooling-and-agent.does: The run summary and the failing test's context package, behind the CLI and the MCP tools.

tooling-and-agent.name: Verification
tooling-and-agent.does: Compares two reports and records whether a fix regressed a covered unit or changed the specification.

tooling-and-agent.name: Feedback
tooling-and-agent.does: The composite action: installs the CLI, uploads the trace, posts the digest and runs the verdict.

tooling-and-agent.name: Analyzers
tooling-and-agent.does: Two Roslyn warnings for test code that compiles but runs outside the lifecycle.

tooling-and-agent.name: Templates
tooling-and-agent.does: Dotnet new prototest scaffolds an API and a suite for it, already composed.

tooling-and-agent.name: Reporting
tooling-and-agent.does: The JSON and HTML report sinks.
